title: Nymph's Grotto
html:
Nymph's Grotto is a Location within Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three of Baldur's Gate 3. It is one of Sharess' Caress' private rooms, currently in use by  Naoise Nallinto.

Overview

This room is the first on the left when ascending to the Upper Floor. Its entrance is overgrown with foliage, and the interior is designed to resemble a forest thicket, in green and arboral hues, with abundant flora, hanging clay pots and a small pool with a nymph-faced bas-relief.

If the player character asks  Mamzell Amira about various services that her pleasure house provides, among others she mentiones "Naoise, our lovely nymph", who is currently catering to her favourite client. However, Naoise is not a nymph, but a wood elf.

Inside the parlour is  Naoise and her client,  Fist Jara. When the party enter the room, a cutscene begins. Unbeknownst to most anyone around, Jara carries a tadpole, which connects with the player character's parasite. The Fist proclaims to know the player character, as the Absolute has already shown their face to her. The latter then triggers Jara's  transformation into a mind flayer, and a fight begins.[1]

Afterwards, a party member can speak to Naoise. If passing a passive  DC 10 Insight Check, she may give them a  Superior Elixir of Arcane Cultivation, or propose experiencing "something more intoxicating than sex" with her.

Agreeing to the latter initiates another cutscene, where Naoise influences the player character's senses, making them feel great and glorious. The character, however, has a choice concerning the focus of this experience. There are the standard set of options, but some Origins and Companions ( Astarion, the  Dark Urge,  Gale,  Karlach,  Minsc, and  Shadowheart) have their own additional, unique options. When Naoise finishes, the character receives the condition  Rapture until the next Long Rest.[2]

Also, near the pool ledge the party can take a copy of an  Archducal Coronation - Admission Pass, supposedly left by ill-fated Jara along with her armour and sword. On the shelf near the entrance lies  Sharess' Caress Rooms Key, which opens not only the door to the balcony in the Nymph's Grotto, but also Elminster's Library and Underdark Pleasures parlours (the latter if it is not currently in use), but it does not open the balcony door of the Devil's Den.

Related locations

  • ⁠Sharess' Caress
  • ⁠Wyrm's Crossing

Characters

  •  Fist Jara
  •  Naoise Nallinto

Notable loot

  • Archducal Coronation - Admission Pass
  • Sharess' Caress Rooms Key
  • Superior Elixir of Arcane Cultivation - optional

Companion approval and Inspiration

Calling Naoise's feelings towards the newborn mind flayer "disgusting", which is only available after a passing an  Insight check, earns  -1,  +1

Accepting Naoise's proposition earns the following inspiration:

  • ⁠Alternative Vocations ( Guild Artisan background)
  • ⁠Exsanguinated Ecstacy ( Haunted One background)
  • ⁠Giving a Private Performance ( Entertainer background)

Notes

  1. ↑ Naoise does not take part in the battle even as a neutral, and Jara as a mind flayer does not attack her. Also, though later Naoise speaks in reverence about the dead Jara's silvery blood, it is actually red, as usual - unlike most other fights with mind flayers.
  2. ↑ Within the cutscene, all party member are pictured from time to time with closed eyes, hanging on Naoise's every word. Nevertheless, the effect is gained only by the character who started the dialogue.
